info.title: Uzu API
info.description: API of the Uzu app. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` extension.

get.summary: Service status, including the database connection.

post.summary: Exchange an Apple identity token for a session; creates the account on first sign-in.
Exchange a Google ID token for a session; creates the account on first sign-in.
Session for a test account. Only available when Auth:AllowDevLogin is true (404 otherwise).
Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token. A token just replaced is accepted again for a short grace period; any later reuse revokes its session.
Revoke a refresh token and the session it belongs to (every token rotated from the same sign-in).
Replace the demo data with a fresh data set (development only; 404 unless DemoData:Enabled). Photo downloads never make it fail.

get.summary: Whether demo data exists, its counts and the demo accounts to sign in as (development only).

delete.summary: Remove the demo accounts and everything that belongs to them, photo files included (development only).

get.summary: Get the signed-in user's profile.

delete.summary: Delete the signed-in user's account: upcoming walks cancelled, dogs, registrations, devices, memberships, blocks and sessions deleted; messages and reports kept without author. Allowed to a suspended account (the only write it may do).

get.summary: Get a user's public profile and dogs.
List the dogs the signed-in user is an owner of, each with all its humans.

post.summary: Create a dog; the signed-in user becomes its owner (20 dogs at most per human, shared dogs included).

get.summary: Get a dog with its humans.

patch.summary: Update a dog (any of its owners). The size cannot change while the dog is registered to an upcoming walk that does not allow the new size.

delete.summary: Delete a dog. Reserved to its last owner: 409 dog.has_other_owners while another owner remains.
Stop being one of the dog's humans. 409 dog.last_owner for its last owner, who can only delete it. Registrations already made are kept.

post.summary: Create an invitation to the dog (any of its owners). Returns the token and the link uzu://invitation/{token}, once; valid 7 days, single use. Only the Owner role is accepted.

get.summary: Pending invitations of the dog (owners only), oldest first, without their tokens.

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation of the dog that has not been used (owners only). Idempotent.

get.summary: Look at an invitation before accepting it: the dog, who invited, the role offered. Gives no right on the dog.

post.summary: Accept an invitation: the signed-in user becomes one of the dog's humans. Returns the dog.

put.summary: Upload or replace the signed-in user's photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB max, metadata removed).
Upload or replace a dog's photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB max, metadata removed).

post.summary: Create a walk organised by the signed-in user; with organizationId, a professional walk of that organisation.

get.summary: Search scheduled upcoming walks around a point, soonest first, then nearest.
Get a walk with its participants, as seen by the signed-in user.

patch.summary: Update a walk before it starts (organizer only).

post.summary: Cancel a walk before it starts (organizer only). Idempotent.
Stop the weekly series of a walk (organizer only): no further walk is created. Idempotent.

get.summary: List the walks the signed-in user organises or takes part in, upcoming or past.

post.summary: Register one or more dogs the signed-in user is an owner of to a walk; all or none are registered. The signed-in user is the human who comes with them.

delete.summary: Cancel a registration before the walk starts: its author or any owner of the dog. When another owner cancels, the author is notified. Idempotent.

post.summary: Accept a pending registration (organizer only). Size, capacity, membership and the organisation's status are checked again.
Decline a pending registration or remove an accepted participant (organizer only).

get.summary: Read a walk's thread (organizer and owners of accepted dogs): the most recent messages, or those older than `before`, oldest first.

post.summary: Write in a walk's thread (organizer and owners of accepted dogs). Refused once the walk is cancelled.

put.summary: Register the signed-in user's device for push notifications. A token registered by another user moves to this one. At most 10 devices per user: the least recently registered ones are removed.

delete.summary: Stop sending push notifications to one of the signed-in user's devices. Idempotent.

get.summary: Get which notifications the signed-in user receives (all by default).

put.summary: Replace which notifications the signed-in user receives.

post.summary: Ask for the creation of an organisation: Pending until an administrator approves it; the signed-in user becomes its owner.

get.summary: Search approved organisations by name or city (case-insensitive), by name.
Get an organisation with its owner and educators, member count, upcoming walks and the signed-in user's membership. Not approved: members and administrators only.
List the signed-in user's memberships in any status, with their organisation (including those awaiting approval).

post.summary: Ask to join an approved organisation; the owner and educators decide.

get.summary: List the accepted members and the pending requests of an organisation (owner and educators only); limit applies to each list.

post.summary: Accept a join request (owner or educator). Idempotent.
Decline a join request (owner or educator). Idempotent.

patch.summary: Change an accepted member's role between Member and Educator (owner only).

delete.summary: Leave an organisation or withdraw a request (own membership), or remove a member (owner or educator; only the owner removes an educator). The sole owner cannot leave. The upcoming registrations of that user to the organisation's walks are cancelled.

post.summary: Block a user: they can no longer register to the signed-in user's walks, and are not told. Idempotent.

get.summary: List the users the signed-in user blocked, most recent first.

post.summary: Report a person, a dog or a walk to the administrators. Only administrators can read reports.

get.summary: List organisations in one status (Pending by default), oldest first.

post.summary: Approve an organisation; its owner is notified. Idempotent.
Reject an organisation (pending, or approved to withdraw it). Idempotent.

get.summary: List reports in one status (Open by default), oldest first, with the reporter and what they are about.

patch.summary: Classify a report and write an administration note.

post.summary: Suspend an account: writes refused (except deleting the account), sessions revoked, weekly series stopped, upcoming walks cancelled with their registrants notified, push devices removed, upcoming registrations to other walks cancelled. Idempotent.
Lift an account's suspension. Restores nothing: series stay stopped, walks and registrations cancelled, devices and sessions gone. Idempotent.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. dog.not_found or validation.failed.
Stable error code, e.g. dog.not_found or validation.failed.

Bearer.description: Access token returned by the /auth endpoints.
